workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:

Before we officially report that it's not possible or suggest moving to the following week, could we do one final verification? Can you please send me the consolidated busy times for Elena and David, in the same format I sent for Priya and Marcus?

Once I have that, I can cross-check all four schedules at once and we can be 100% certain that no slot was missed. It's always good to double-check before declaring something impossible.
